description: Zentrale KidMotion Bildwelt. Google Flow erzeugt alle sichtbaren Texte im Bild. Remotion darf ausschliesslich den Countdown-Timer ueber das statische Bild legen. Ab Szenenstruktur V3 wird zuerst ein Cover aus drei Kandidaten vom Nutzer ausgewaehlt; dieses Cover wird Szene 01 und primaere Referenz fuer alle weiteren Szenen.
rules: 16:9 landscape, premium stylized 3D kids animation look
exactly one recurring KidMotion child per episode
child identity follows characters/CHARACTER_BIBLE.md
same face, hair, age appearance, skin tone and body proportions throughout one episode
generate exactly three cover candidates first and STOP until the user explicitly chooses one
the selected cover is renamed Szene 01.png and becomes the primary character/outfit/world/color reference
all remaining final images are named Szene 02.png through Szene 17.png and stored in the same flat image folder
full body must remain readable for all exercise poses
exercise pose must be understandable from one still image
bright clean child-friendly lighting and uncluttered composition
generic original sports environments only; no real team, league, sponsor or brand logos
Szene 05 is the secondary exercise title/instruction UI reference for Szene 06 through Szene 16
ALL visible text except the changing countdown number is generated directly by Google Flow inside the source image
Szene 02 contains the complete Intro text
Szene 03 contains the complete Safety text
Szene 04 contains LET'S BEGIN!
Szene 05 through Szene 16 contain exercise title bottom-left plus instruction top-right
Szene 17 contains GREAT JOB! and WORKOUT COMPLETE
top-left 220x220 px remains clear on exercise images for the Remotion timer
there is no Remotion progress bar
Rest reuses the next exercise image and Remotion adds only the countdown timer
forbidden: generating Szene 02 or later before explicit user cover selection
cropped hands, feet or important joints
